title: MeetingJoin
description: The answer of `GET /v1/meetings/{meeting_id}/join` (ADR-0024 amendment 4): the Google Meet link of a meeting Tilo hosts, for that meeting's owner only, read from the host account's event when the owner clicks and stored nowhere (rules MJ-01 to MJ-10 in `meeting_join.rules.md`). It is a response body, never a record: no store, cache, event, card, notification, archive record or log line holds it, and `meeting.schema.json` and `calendar_entry.schema.json` still have no field that can. `join_url` is exactly `https://meet.google.com/` and a three-four-three lower-case meeting code: no other scheme, host, user info, port, path, query or fragment (36 characters, so a trailing newline is refused in every engine). `expires_at` is the server's clock plus 60 seconds: the client drops the link then, or when the view closes, and asks again on the next click.
